headline: An ordinary high schooler into CS & academia
bioMarkdown:
Not great at programming — no competitive programming, and on the security side I really only know some cryptography theory. The rest I'm not that familiar with.

Almost everything I've picked up is self-taught. I came from a humanities track and switched over from zero; I used to do graphic design and video editing. I've been in tech for less than a year, and I've only really touched security for about a month (not counting the earlier phase where I only knew crypto theory). My CTF results are pretty bad, and I haven't done many contests.

I'm interested in both academia and engineering, so I've taken quite a bit of math ahead of time — though I'm not great at math either — and I'm working on a few small research projects now.
